env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A spread composite in a select receive target must lower on both paths:
# the spread's temporary is declared where the store text reads it, and the
# frozen index operands appear exactly once, so plain go builds the ejected
# module and its output matches the native run.
cd m
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/spread_recv.lgo main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/spread_recv.out expected.txt
logos run .
cmp stdout expected.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
exists $UPROOT1274/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1274/bin/go run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/spreadrecv

go 1.27
